goddard-fortran-ecosystem/gftl.manifest:
name="gftl"
version="0.0.0"
license="Apache-2.0"
[library]
source-dir="playground-library"
include-dir=["include"]
[build]
auto-executables=false
auto-examples=false
auto-tests=false
[install]
library=true

scope: gFTL is a header/template library, not a standalone compiled library. The catalog supplies a small integer-vector instantiation using the upstream v2 template, then verifies growth to 100 elements, retrieval of every stored square, and the independent sum 338350. Audited generated include files are committed as checksum-locked assets, with original m4 input hashes; generation follows the pinned CMake rules while omitting diagnostic line markers. GNU m4 on Windows and Linux reproduces identical assets. N4 covers the tested storage container. Other template/container configurations are not verified.
generated_source_support: See ../../fpm-generated-sources.md. Audited assets and original input hashes are included in local project exports; CMake and m4 do not run during visitor preparation.
